name: 飞雷神锚点
description: 水门每回合开始时选择一处位置作为飞雷神锚点，最多保留三个。
skillCode: var minato = context.rulePiece; var turnPlayerId = context.triggerPlayerId || context.playerId; if (!minato || minato.currentHp <= 0 || minato.ownerPlayerId !== turnPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.targetX === undefined || context.targetY === undefined) return { needsTargetSelection: true, targetType: 'cell', range: 99, filter: 'all', playerId: minato.ownerPlayerId, title: minato.name + '选择飞雷神锚点' }; var x = context.targetX; var y = context.targetY; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(t) { return t.x === x && t.y === y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '飞雷神锚点必须放在可行走格' }; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; if (!battle.extensions.minatoAnchors) battle.extensions.minatoAnchors = []; if (!battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = []; var anchors = battle.extensions.minatoAnchors; var existing = anchors.find(function(a) { return a.sourceId === minato.instanceId && a.x === x && a.y === y; }); if (existing) existing.createdAt = Date.now(); else anchors.push({ x: x, y: y, sourceId: minato.instanceId, ownerPlayerId: minato.ownerPlayerId, createdAt: Date.now() }); battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(te) { return !(te.tileType === 'flying-raijin-anchor' && te.sourceId === minato.instanceId && te.x === x && te.y === y); }); battle.extensions.tileEffects.push({ x: x, y: y, sourceId: minato.instanceId, tileType: 'flying-raijin-anchor', icon: '⚡', bgColor: 'rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.14)', boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.75)', iconPosition: 'top-left' }); while (anchors.filter(function(a) { return a.sourceId === minato.instanceId; }).length > 3) { var oldest = anchors.filter(function(a) { return a.sourceId === minato.instanceId; }).sort(function(a,b) { return (a.createdAt || 0) - (b.createdAt || 0); })[0]; battle.extensions.minatoAnchors = anchors = anchors.filter(function(a) { return a !== oldest; }); battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(te) { return !(te.tileType === 'flying-raijin-anchor' && te.sourceId === minato.instanceId && te.x === oldest.x && te.y === oldest.y); }); } return { success: true, message: minato.name + '标记飞雷神锚点(' + x + ',' + y + ')' };
